notablePrerequisites: All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures..
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Gwenna.
Repeat.
